title: Sankofa
text: A word from the Akan language of Ghana, often shown as a bird looking backward while its feet face forward. It expresses the idea that we can return to the past to learn what we need for the future.

title: Adinkra
text: Visual symbols associated with the Akan peoples of West Africa. Each symbol stands for an idea or a proverb. They appear on cloth, pottery, walls and many other things.

title: Ghana
text: A country in West Africa on the Gulf of Guinea. Its capital is Accra. The Akan language family, which includes Twi and Fante, is widely spoken there.
